name: 10 Mile 532nm Adjustable Focus Green Laser Pointer Beam Light Pen + Star Cap 5mw
description:
Usage: Ideal for presentations, teaching, and as an indicator on projection screens or videos.

Dual Function: Comes with a star lamp cap to project variable patterns at night; remove the cap for a single beam pointer.

Astronomy Use: Can be used to point across the sky and locate stars in clear nights.

Design: Lightweight, compact, and easy to carry in your pocket or handbag.

Technology: Built with advanced optics and microelectronics for high performance.

Light Color: Green beam for enhanced visibility and clear focus on the target.
